plugins.name: triforce
plugins.description: Runs a change through an orchestrated multi-agent workflow — zelda plans and merges on Opus, link executes in isolation on Sonnet, and ganondorf renders a verdict on the merged diff against a frozen, user-sourced criteria list. The audit is required but never blocking, bounded by a monotone per-branch invocation ledger rather than by the reviewer's own judgement, so it terminates instead of finding something every round.
